arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat
TARGET=/tmp/rea-audit-plcodex-20261030-1647
test ! -e "$TARGET"
git -c credential.helper= clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$TARGET"
test "$(git -C "$TARGET" rev-parse HEAD)" = "4a5c5ba5876bad079ec4edf401416804c18bc521"
python3 - "$TARGET" <<'PY'
import sys,subprocess,collections
from pathlib import Path
p=Path(sys.argv[1]); a=subprocess.check_output(['git','-C',str(p),'ls-files','-z']).decode().split('\x00');a=[x for x in a if x]
print('INVENTORY_REPO',p,'FILES',len(a),flush=True)
ext=collections.Counter(Path(x).suffix or '(none)' for x in a)
print('FILE_TYPES',dict(ext.most_common(20)),flush=True)
print('TREE_START')
for x in a[:340]:
 z=p/x
 print(f'{x} [{z.stat().st_size if z.is_file() else "?"} bytes]')
print('TREE_END')
if len(a)>340:print('FILES_OMITTED',len(a)-340)
for name in ['README.md','AGENTS.md','package.json','pyproject.toml','requirements.txt','Makefile','Dockerfile','.github/CODEOWNERS','SECURITY.md']:
 z=p/name
 if z.is_file():
  s=z.read_text(errors='replace').splitlines()
  print('FILE_PREVIEW_BEGIN',name,'TOTAL_LINES',len(s))
  for i,x in enumerate(s[:125],1):print(f'{i:04d} {x[:450]}')
  print('FILE_PREVIEW_END',name)
print('CANDIDATE_CODE_FILES',*[x for x in a if any(y in x.lower() for y in ('coordinat','supervis','agent','worker','human','dispatch','planner','selection','policy','workflow','codex','test','security'))][:110],sep='\n')
print('INVENTORY_PASS')
PY
